difficulty_reason: The current author constructs relative Cartesian smooth neighborhoods and a principal Cartier divisor, uses cap-product duality and principal triviality to prove effaceability, then combines relative quasi-finite presentation with finite pushforward and a separate generic-special-fiber lifting argument. These steps prove full Zariski exactness over arbitrary residue fields, not a routine substitution into an existing exact sequence.
